record.question: Which one of the following is not among the salient features of new National Agricultural Policy 2000?
options: 4% growth rate per annum for the next two decades
record.explanation: National Agricultural Policy 2000 aimed at biotechnology promotion, private investment in agriculture and a 4% annual growth target. Privatisation of agricultural markets is the item that does not fit the policy's stated features, so it is chosen as the exception.
